FX-SLANT-001.says: The settings as they start: slant 0, height 100: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SLANT-002.says: Slant 30, stretching off, the floor at the bottom: the top leans right and the picture sinks to cos 30 of its height, its leant edges as long as they stood.

FX-SLANT-003.says: Slant 30, stretching on: the top leans right and the height stays.

FX-SLANT-004.says: Slant -30, stretching on: the top leans left.

FX-SLANT-005.says: Slant 30, stretching on, the floor through the middle: the top leans right and the bottom left.

FX-SLANT-006.says: Slant 30, stretching on, the floor at the top: the top row stays and the bottom leans left.

FX-SLANT-007.says: Slant 0, height 50, stretching on: squashed to half height onto the floor, the top half transparent.

FX-SLANT-008.says: Slant 0, height 200, stretching on, the floor through the middle: stretched to twice the height about the middle.

FX-SLANT-010.says: Slant 45, stretching on, height 50, set color on in red: a red shadow lying down to the right, as soft at its edges as the drawing.

FX-SLANT-011.says: Slant keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 60 at frame 4, linear, stretching on: frame 0 the drawing, frame 2 FX-SLANT-003.

FX-SLANT-012.says: Height eased from 0 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots, stretching on: at frame 2 it would pass 1000 and is held there.

FX-SLANT-013.says: FX-SLANT-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows.

FX-SLANT-014.says: Slant 80, stretching off: leant almost flat, cos 80 of its height, most of it past the right edge and cut.

FX-SLANT-015.says: Floor keyed from 50, 100 at frame 0 to 50, 0 at frame 4, slant 30, stretching on: frame 0 FX-SLANT-003, frame 2 FX-SLANT-005, frame 4 FX-SLANT-006.

FX-SLANT-016.says: Slant 81, above 80. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
